questions.statement: Choose the correct preposition: "The cat is sleeping ___ the sofa."
questions.context: Clase de ingles de sexto grado en la que se repasan las preposiciones de lugar del primer nivel.

options.feedback: in means inside something, and the cat is not inside the sofa.
on indicates that the cat is resting on top of the sofa, which is the position described.
under would mean the cat is below the piece of furniture.
between requires two objects on the sides, and here only the sofa is mentioned.

questions.explanation: Las preposiciones de lugar del primer nivel se eligen segun la relacion fisica del objeto con el referente. Un animal o un objeto que descansa sobre una superficie lleva on, y esa es la lectura natural de la oracion.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct preposition: "The dictionary is ___ the bookshelf, next to the grammar book."
questions.context: Ejercicio de localizacion de un libro en una biblioteca escolar.

options.feedback: on would indicate the dictionary is resting on a surface different from the shelf.
in describes being inside a piece of furniture such as the shelf, where the dictionary is kept.
under would mean it is below the shelf and not beside it.
over indicates being above and sometimes crossing over, which does not describe a book that is stored.

questions.explanation: Los muebles de almacenamiento como estantes, cajones y armarios piden in, porque el objeto queda dentro de un espacio con volumen. Esa distincion se opone a on, que se reserva para superficies horizontales.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "The pen is on the desk and the eraser is under the desk." Where is the eraser?
questions.context: Lectura de un texto sobre la colocacion de los objetos en un escritorio.

options.feedback: The text says the pen is on the desk, not the eraser.
The second part of the text places it literally under the desk.
The drawer is not mentioned in the text.
The window does not appear in the sentence either.

questions.explanation: En un texto con dos objetos y dos lugares, el lector debe emparejar cada objeto con su lugar correspondiente. La clave es notar que cada sustantivo tiene su propio sintagma de lugar y que no deben intercambiarse.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence places the object correctly with a preposition of zone?
questions.context: Ejercicio de escritura de la descripcion de una habitacion.

options.text: There is a mirror in the wall.
options.feedback: A mirror is not placed inside the wall but on its surface, with on the wall.

options.text: There is a mirror on the wall.
options.feedback: On the wall is the preposition of zone used for a mirror fixed to the vertical surface of the wall.

options.text: There is a mirror under the wall.
options.feedback: A hung mirror is not described as being under the wall.

options.text: There is a mirror between wall.
options.feedback: between requires two referents, and the sentence also needs an article before wall.

questions.explanation: Los objetos planos y fijos como espejos, cuadros y carteles se sitúan con on the wall. Combinar una preposicion de interioridad con un objeto que esta en la superficie es un error tipico que se corrige-visualizando la escena.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Where do you keep your pens? Choose the best answer.
questions.context: Ejercicio de reflexion sobre la preparacion de un escritorio escolar.

options.feedback: at school indicates the general place and does not answer where the pens are kept.

options.text: I keep them in my pencil case.
options.feedback: in my pencil case answers where the pens are kept, which is what the sentence asks.
very well answers how, not where.

options.text: I keep them at eight o'clock.
options.feedback: That answer gives a time and not a place.

questions.explanation: La palabra where exige una respuesta de lugar, y las demas opciones responden a otras preguntas como when o how. Reconocer el tipo de respuesta esperado evita que el estudiante produzca una frase correcta pero impertinente.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete the sentence: "The teacher is standing ___ the students, in front of the board."
questions.context: Ejercicio de descripcion de la sala de clase vista desde un punto de referencia.

options.feedback: behind would indicate the teacher is at the back of the classroom.
near is an approximation and does not describe the position of the teacher facing the class.
between requires two referents on both sides, and here only a front area is described.
in front of the students indicates the teacher is in the area the students face.

questions.explanation: Las preposiciones que expresan zonas de la clase como in front of y behind se distinguen segun la perspectiva del observador. Tomar como referencia a los estudiantes y no a la pizarra es lo que permite elegir correctamente la preposicion.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Write your answers on the sheet, not in the notebook." Where should the student write?
questions.context: Ejercicio de lectura de las instrucciones de una prueba escolar.

options.feedback: The text expressly forbids writing in the notebook.
The first part of the instruction indicates the answers go on the sheet.
The board is not mentioned as a place to write in this test.
The text mentions no book, and the wording of the contrast rules it out too.

questions.explanation: La construccion con not distingue de manera explicita una opcion de otra dentro del mismo enunciado. Reconocer que la negacion descarta una de las dos opciones permite responder sin ambiguedad incluso con dos lugares mencionados.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Choose the correct question: "___ shall we meet? At the library."
questions.context: Ejercicio de negociacion de una cita entre companeros.

options.feedback: That wh-word produces a place question and not a time question.
when asks about the moment, and the answer At the library responds to a question about when, not about exactly where.
why asks for a reason and the answer does not express one.
who asks for a person and the answer is a place.

questions.explanation: A veces la palabra interrogativa y el contenido esperado de la respuesta no coinciden exactamente, y lo que manda es el sentido de la conversacion. En este ejercicio el acuerdo es en un momento concreto, por lo que when es la opcion que reconstruye la frase.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "The new student sits between Laura and me." Who sits next to the new student?
questions.context: Ejercicio de reflexion sobre la ubicacion de un nuevo companero en el aula.

options.feedback: between Laura and me indicates the new student is between Laura and the speaker.
The phrase mentions two neighbouring people and not only one.
The teacher does not appear in the phrase as a neighbour.
Being between two people means having neighbours on both sides.

questions.explanation: La preposicion between define una relacion de tres elementos: el referente y dos vecinos. En este caso el nuevo estudiante tiene a Laura y al hablante a cada lado, lo que permite responder nombrando a las dos personas.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which sentence describes the layout in the drawing correctly?
questions.context: Prueba de la unidad para cerrar el trimestre.

options.text: The table is behind the sofa.
options.feedback: The drawing shows the table in front of the sofa and not behind it.

options.text: The table is in front of the sofa.
options.feedback: The description places the table in the front area relative to the sofa.

options.text: The armchairs are under the sofa.
options.feedback: The armchairs appear at the sides of the sofa and not underneath it.

options.text: The table is between two sofas.
options.feedback: The drawing has only one sofa, and the table does not occupy the space between the armchairs.

questions.explanation: Las cuatro relaciones espaciales del primer nivel son on, in, under y las de zona como in front of y behind. Traducir un dibujo exige identificar primero cual de esas relaciones domina y despues escoger la preposicion que la nombra.
questions.subject: ingles
